outcome: killed by timeout at 12 h with the search still running
meaning: No conclusion of any kind about D_{0,1} # 10_3. The search did not finish, so this is not even coverage of the box. It is a record that the attempt was made and how far the budget went.
why_this_record_exists: Two earlier partners were killed at 5 h and left NOTHING, because a row is appended only when a partner search returns. The heartbeat added to teichner_certify.py writes the knot, partner, sum crossing number and start time before the long call. This file is that heartbeat surviving its kill, which is the behaviour the patch was for.
budget_guidance: Cost is grossly superlinear in the crossing number of the sum: 4.2 h at 31, 7.96 h at 33, more than 12 h at 35. Roughly a doubling per two crossings. Budget at least 24 h for a 35-crossing sum in this box, and do not extrapolate linearly.
